description: CHANGES ... AT (STREAM => '<name>') starts the change window at a stream's own offset, so it answers exactly what that stream reports - the same rows, the same metadata columns - without consuming it. Each delta row rendered SQL-side as c1|METADATA$ACTION|METADATA$ISUPDATE and sorted, so sets of changes compare cleanly: DEFAULT is the whole delta, APPEND_ONLY is the rows APPENDED in the window (not the net delta's insert half - an appended-then-updated row keeps the value it was appended with, an appended-then-deleted row survives, a merely-updated pre-existing row is absent), an APPEND_ONLY stream agrees with CHANGES(APPEND_ONLY), a stream over another table contributes nothing, an unknown stream names itself in the error, and qualified stream names resolve. Converted 1:1 from features/ChangesAtStreamTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE ct (c1 INTEGER, c2 VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO ct VALUES (1, 'a'), (2, 'b')
CREATE STREAM s1 ON TABLE ct
INSERT INTO ct VALUES (3, 'c')
UPDATE ct SET c2 = 'B' WHERE c1 = 2
DELETE FROM ct WHERE c1 = 1
SELECT "C1" || '|' || "METADATA$ACTION" || '|' || TO_VARCHAR("METADATA$ISUPDATE") AS r FROM ct CHANGES (INFORMATION => DEFAULT) AT (STREAM => 's1') ORDER BY r
SELECT "C1" || '|' || "METADATA$ACTION" || '|' || TO_VARCHAR("METADATA$ISUPDATE") AS r FROM s1 ORDER BY r
